04FAQs

Working with a Pallikaranai-based agency

Do I need to be in Pallikaranai to work with you?

No. We work with businesses across Chennai. Being local helps, but most projects run smoothly over phone, WhatsApp and video calls.

Do you have offices in other areas?

No. Kavitha Digital is based in Pallikaranai only. Our location pages describe how we serve businesses in each area — they are not branch offices.

Can you help my business rank in my area?

Yes. Local SEO focuses on the areas you genuinely serve, using your Google Business Profile, reviews and useful local content.
